original.question: Shiela amafunika kupereka 15-tsamba kalata ya kafukufuku. Iye kale adaliza kulemba 1/3 ya kalata ya kafukufuku. Kodi tsamba zingati zatsala kulemba?
original.answer:
Shiela alemba kale 1/3 ya kalata ya kafukufuku zomwe ndi 15 tsamba*1/3 = <<15*1/3=5>>5 tsamba.
Choncho, akufunika kulemba 15 tsamba - 5 tsamba = <<15-5=10>>10 tsamba.
